## Animals

| | Animal | St | Dx | To | In | Wi | Pr | Those born under it |
|---:|---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|---|
| 1 | Salamander | −1 | +1 | 0 | +1 | 0 | 0 | The smallest racer, who rode the Hydra across the river and leapt through the gate first: quick and clever, if slight. |
| 2 | Hydra | 0 | 0 | +2 | −1 | 0 | 0 | The strongest swimmer, who carried the Salamander across and was beaten by it at the gate: tireless and hard to kill, but of many minds. |
| 3 | Manticore | +1 | 0 | +1 | 0 | 0 | −1 | Ran the whole course without rest while every other racer fled its path: fierce and relentless, and little loved. |
| 4 | Unicorn | 0 | +1 | −1 | 0 | 0 | +1 | Crossed the river leaping from stone to stone without wetting a hoof: graceful and fair, and easily hurt. |
| 5 | Wyvern | +1 | −1 | 0 | 0 | 0 | +1 | Could have flown in first, but stopped to burn a path through the Mistwood for those behind: bold and generous, and clumsy on the ground. |
| 6 | Basilisk | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | +2 | −1 | Rode coiled around the Roc's talon and slid off in front of it at the gate: patient and unblinking, and trusted by no one. |
| 7 | Roc | +2 | 0 | 0 | −1 | 0 | 0 | The mightiest of fliers, who soared so high it lost sight of the gate: powerful and proud, and not one for details. |
| 8 | Griffin | 0 | −1 | 0 | 0 | +1 | +1 | Landed on every hilltop on the way to watch over its gold: noble and watchful, and stiff in its ways. |
| 9 | Sphinx | 0 | −1 | 0 | +2 | 0 | 0 | Stopped to set every racer it met a riddle, and lost the morning to those who answered: wise and cunning, and slow to move. |
| 10 | Phoenix | −1 | 0 | +1 | 0 | 0 | +1 | Burned to ash in the noon of the Glass Waste and rose again at dusk to finish: hard to keep down and bright to behold, but frail between fires. |
| 11 | Kraken | +1 | −1 | 0 | 0 | +1 | 0 | Could not leave the water, so swam the long way round by sea and arrived on the evening tide: strong and deep, and ungainly ashore. |
| 12 | Barghest | 0 | 0 | +1 | 0 | +1 | −1 | The black hound who ran last on purpose, to see every racer through, and was given the last year for it: loyal and steadfast, and grim company. |
